heading: Regex without a slot width bound
text:
### Regex without a slot width bound [LNLS.3.7]

A `~` or `!~` regex expression whose left-hand operand is a `String`
slot without a declared `capacity` ([LSTR.11.1]) is a compile error
(`DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_UNBOUNDED_REGEX`) in a `linear_scan: false` file.

When the slot declares `capacity N`, the regex match cost is O(N × P),
where both N (the slot's bound in codepoints, at most 4N bytes) and P
(pattern length, fixed in DSC) are compile-time constants.  This is bounded
and allowed.
